rule: Only mechanism/boundary/test changes are emitted as transformed hypotheses; unchanged ideas are not renamed.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Mutating provider retry authority is a time-bounded typed capability whose validity requires exact same-intent binding plus demonstrably live provider idempotency retention; UNKNOWN/EXPIRED retention denies mutation while separately typed read-only reconciliation may remain allowed.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Turns idempotency from a boolean/key property into a time-bounded authority predicate.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: A real provider contract and timeout-after-acceptance test proves safe duplicate prevention after the purported unknown/expired horizon.
transformed_hypotheses.next_test: Real provider fault injection with retained, expired and unknown retention states.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Effect terminalization is valid only as a referentially closed causal transaction: exact execution generation plus resolvable canonical GWT/use, causal-credit and admitted-delta support, or an explicitly typed no-learning branch.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Replaces opaque-ID presence with storage/evidence-level referential closure and explicitly permits a no-learning outcome path.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Fabricated/foreign/stale support IDs can be accepted without producing incorrect causal credit or learning under replay/recovery.
transformed_hypotheses.next_test: Foreign-key/equivalent support receipts plus fabrication, stale-epoch, shuffled and no-learning controls.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Finished self.root boot continuity composes three distinct gates: trusted binary/build attestation, exactly one selected semantic-lineage head with parent-bound atomic CAS, and a surviving monotonic rollback/recovery anchor; no one gate substitutes for the others.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Separates artifact provenance, semantic continuation and rollback authority rather than using one overloaded identity scalar.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: A simpler two-part scheme rejects sibling/transplant/stale/rollback attacks under the declared failure domain with equal recovery reliability and lower cost.
transformed_hypotheses.next_test: Integrate selected-head candidate into boot evaluator, then adversarially combine semantic twins with external-anchor rollback/loss and trusted-builder mismatch.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Live fusion chooses TARGETED, DENSE or DIGEST/REPAIR mode from dependency-span uncertainty and expected miss cost; anti-entropy provides correctness closure, while routing precision provides efficiency only.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Moves from one adaptive routing policy to a mode controller whose correctness does not depend on perfect topology.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: One simpler fixed routing mode is Pareto-superior on real replay, faults and resource shadows.
transformed_hypotheses.next_test: Real-repo broadcast/tag-only/adaptive-mode replay with stale/missing edges, duplicates, reorder and restart.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Recurrent compute is admitted/continued by task-conditioned unresolved pressure and measured marginal utility, while GWT broadcast credit requires downstream receiver-use/effect closure; ignition never by itself justifies more recurrence.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Couples adaptive compute admission to causal outcome/readout rather than treating recurrence or ignition as intrinsically valuable.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Fixed recurrence achieves equal/better held-out outcomes under matched cost and causal closure, or ignition predicts outcomes without receiver-use mediation.
transformed_hypotheses.next_test: Factorial fixed/adaptive recurrence x truthful/shuffled/no-use receiver controls.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Learned reward/value representation may be scalar, typed or distributional, but non-negotiable safety/effect/resource constraints remain separate typed gates; material reward still requires verified outcome plus causal credit.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Prevents richer reward representations from silently absorbing hard constraints and makes simpler scalar+constraint architecture a mandatory comparator.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Joint reward encoding preserves all hard constraints, calibration, reversal/OOD robustness and recovery with lower complexity.
transformed_hypotheses.next_test: Scalar+constraints vs typed+constraints vs distributional+constraints under reversal, safety conflict, self-reward poisoning and resource shifts.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: Hyperposition is retained for unresolved alternatives or higher-order relations only when a measured pairwise reduction loses task-relevant invariants; otherwise the simpler weighted pairwise projection is preferred.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Demotes higher-order topology from architectural presumption to conditional representation chosen by irreducibility tests.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: No tested target workload exhibits an invariant or decision advantage over pairwise projection within budget.
transformed_hypotheses.next_test: Pairwise-reduction battery over current Hyperposition workloads with transition/outcome equivalence and resource measurements.

transformed_hypotheses.claim: SQLite WAL continuity acceptance is keyed to exact source/build fix provenance or a machine-checked topology proof, never only to reported semantic version or a short passing canary.
transformed_hypotheses.changed: Turns upstream race information into an explicit reproducible release gate with two admissible closure paths.
transformed_hypotheses.falsifier: Primary Ubuntu build provenance proves the backport or topology analysis excludes all trigger conditions.
transformed_hypotheses.next_test: Resolve libsqlite3-0 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7 source patch lineage; otherwise upgrade to known fixed build and rerun crash/recovery matrix.
